system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

Mutated Feature: Spiraling Chains

Your chakra suffuses you with strength, resilience, and raw strength. Allowing you the ability to resist falling when others would have long since done so.

You gain immunity to the negative effects of losing a Clash. Also, once per turn, when you would be reduced to 0 hit points, you can spend your reaction to instead spend a number of Chakra dice, regaining the result as hit points. If this would cause you to have 1 or more hit points after the damage calculation, you regain the spent reaction.
